positions.name: ProbeAsAssertionCarrier
positions.frame: what is the relationship between this probe artifact and the enrollment-behavior claim it exists to carry?
positions.why: src-1 states the e2e-suite assertion as a settled 'Decision:'; src-2 immediately reframes the probe itself as existing 'only to carry that assertion' — the two segments are read together as one self-referential unit (claim + its vehicle) rather than as independent statements about the world. The register direction's shared TechnicalSelfDescription mint (technical/matter-of-fact across both) and the matching authority-ranking and competence reads across both segments support treating them as one coherent directional group rather than two isolated witnesses.
